_comment: What the release archive may not hold. tools/package_contents.cjs reads this, the CI package job runs it on the unzipped archive, and tests/package_contents_js.cjs runs it on `git archive` of the working tree. Each entry of refuse is a regular expression on a path relative to the module folder, with forward slashes. php_allowed lists the only places a .php file may ship; text_refuse lists strings no shipped text file may hold.

refuse.why: test scripts run over HTTP from the module folder (FRM-1)
live test run sheets and their fixtures (FRM-15)
a development diagram that loads fonts from a CDN (FRM-15)

text_refuse.why: a page of the module must not load from a font CDN (FRM-15)
